title: Rejects a local-path-only artifact review request
query: A worker finished TASK-0301 and wants to Telegram Kenji: 'Review tickets/TASK-0301/artifacts/report.md'. Prepare the review request.
reference_points: Does not send a local-path-only Telegram message
Requires a phone-readable summary, excerpt, options, or phone-openable link
Labels local filesystem paths as desktop-only when included
Records fallback if the artifact cannot be summarized honestly
Keeps the worker thread as the reply route owner
anti_patterns: Pastes a giant report without a clear decision
Creates a new approval queue instead of routing replies to the worker

title: Records sent message id or fallback receipt
query: A worker has produced an ablation proof report with summary and archive-safe artifact refs. Telegram is configured and CODEX_THREAD_ID is available. What should the finish receipt include?
reference_points: Uses telegram-message as the send route
Includes ticket id, worker thread/session ref, artifact refs, requested reply action, and Telegram message id
Binds feedback_channel=telegram, feedback_policy=ask_when_artifact_ready, and the worker_thread_ref reply route
Logs a review-cycle entry with artifact refs, human question, expected signal, Telegram status, and next action after reply
Applies the worker-artifact-review and telegram-message QA checklists
Records a blocker instead of silently succeeding if sending fails
Satisfies the turn exit gate before stopping while waiting for Kenji
Does not mark publish/post/spend approval as granted
anti_patterns: Claims the review was requested without a message id or fallback
Omits the worker thread reply route
Stops as waiting for Kenji without a Telegram send receipt or blocker
Treats message sent as final external-action approval

title: Escalates an unanswered Telegram review request through phone-chaser
query: A worker sent Kenji a Telegram review request for TASK-0304 yesterday with a message id and archive-safe artifact refs. The worker is still blocked on approve/revise/reject and the caller says ignored Telegram should be chased by phone. What should happen now?
reference_points: Treats phone-chaser as an escalation after the unanswered Telegram, not as the first review request
Uses a short Kenji-facing phone message with one concrete reply action
Applies phone-chaser guardrails for allowed recipient, no secrets, and sanitized receipt
Records Telegram message id, phone-chaser dispatch id or blocker, worker thread ref, artifact refs, and requested reply action
Preserves the worker thread as the reply route and records the escalation in the review cycle
Does not treat the phone call as approval to publish, post, spend, deploy, or mutate external accounts
anti_patterns: Creates a new approval queue instead of routing the answer to the worker thread
Calls without a prior unanswered review ping or explicit chase intent
Leaves no dispatch receipt or blocker

title: Creates a phone-readable review request for content artifacts
query: A worker finished a storyboard and two hook variants for a harness-engineering video. Ask Kenji to review it without posting.
reference_points: Summarizes the storyboard/hook options in Telegram-readable form
Asks one clear reply action such as choose A/B, revise, or reject with reason
States that posting/publishing remains gated
Includes archive-safe artifact refs as desktop-only refs after the reviewable content
Records the request in the caller-owned ticket or progress surface
anti_patterns: Asks Kenji to review an unspecified video idea
Combines review with public posting approval
Requires desktop access to know what decision is being requested
